race.comment: Looks a race in three. TASSORATI (11) returned a good figure two back when she led and held on gamely for third over this distance at Eagle Farm at the most recent outing. Not quite as effective last start when she reverted to 1400m. Beautifully weighted after the claim and back to the mile she looks the goods. CIRQUE DE LA VIE (9) turned in an eye-catcher first-up over 1400m at the Sunshine Coast, coming from near the tail to be beaten a neck. Enjoys the gun run out of gate one and the extra trip looks perfect at this stage of the prep. BRASS BAND (1) just missed in a three-way go over this course and distance recently, the third minor placing in succession. Racing well enough to give this a shake. Bit of a gap to the next best SOMETHING SHINY (2) who might improve with the winkers removed. READY TO BOIL (12) is very fit and managed a placing at Esk last start. This is much harder so exotics only.
